Maya / NovaHealth procurement team —

Following our demo last week, attached is a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) that ties evaluation milestones to legal gating (MSA/DPA/order form) and a short escrow/evidence cadence for acceptance. Key asks up front:

- Confirm whether a 90‑day evidence / audit log escrow window is acceptable for evaluation pilots.
- Confirm procurement lead(s) and preferred signature owner for the order form.
- Any mandatory clauses from your SOC2/infosec checklist that must be captured in the DPA redline?

Summary (high level):
- Week 0–2: Pilot eval (access + integration) — Redwood provides audit-log extract and KV cache retention policy.
- Week 3–4: Evidence deliverable (sample logs + SOC2 artefacts) — escrowed for 90 days.
- Week 5: Order form negotiation / signature window (DocuSign link to follow)
- Post-sign: MSA effective date tie-in and production onramp.

Attachment: redline_guidance.pdf (pdf) — short notes on typical DPA language we can offer to speed review.

If this looks reasonable I’ll loop in legal for a quick alignment and propose a sign-by date to keep the pilot runway tight.

— Karthik

Maya / team —

Quick legal response after review of the guidance and NovaHealth’s ask:

- Escrow / evidence: We can agree to a 90‑day escrow for evaluation materials with a signed acceptance of how access requests are handled (escrow custodian + audit trail). If NovaHealth requires 180‑day retention of raw logs we will instead provide a certified time‑boxed export plus a notarized delivery certificate (this is our standard approach for pilots).
- Data jurisdiction & access: any escrowed files will be stored in AWS us‑west‑2 and access will be strictly admin‑only with a documented request process (we will include the responsibility matrix in the DPA).
- Billing vs MSA effective date: proposed snippet for order form: "Billing for pilot usage will be invoiced upon commencement of production traffic as defined in Section X (production cutover). The MSA becomes effective on signature; the order form may specify a deferred billing start date." Please confirm whether NovaHealth would prefer invoice timing tied to cutover or a fixed calendar date after signature.

Attachment: DPA_redlines.docx — contains clean comments for the 90‑day escrow clause and an alternate clause for 180‑day export.

Suggested gating timeline (legal view):
- Day 0 (sign-off on MAP) — Redwood provides access tokens for pilot.
- Day 14 — evidence export delivered to escrow (if requested) and QA checklist completed.
- Day 21 — order form final redline; target signature window opens.
- Day 28 — sign-by target to avoid drift; fallback: 2‑week extension with increased evidence cadence.

If this aligns I’ll prepare a short tracked DPA and we can push to DocuSign for the order form.
